_comment: plan.md §11c T11.7: each selected test/parallel file of the pinned Node, as pass, fail or skip with a reason. node-suite.test.ts enforces it both ways: a pass that fails, or a fail that passes, fails the run. A test that fails under the pinned Node itself is a skip, never a fail. fetch.ts downloads each file and the test/fixtures files it lists under "fixtures".
